Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.

# ── Figure & grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 15), dpi=150)
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    2, 2,
    height_ratios=[1.2, 1],
    width_ratios=[1.4, 1],
    hspace=0.32, wspace=0.28,
    left=0.18, right=0.82, top=0.93, bottom=0.06,
)

fig.suptitle(
    'Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 → 2024',
    fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='#222222', y=0.97,
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A — Slope / Bump Chart: Top-10 cause rank changes
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_slope = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])

causes_1990 = {d['cause']: d for d in data['top10_daly_causes']['data'] if d['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {d['cause']: d for d in data['top10_daly_causes']['data'] if d['year'] == 2024}
all_causes = list(dict.fromkeys(
    [d['cause'] for d in data['top10_daly_causes']['data']]
))

for cause in all_causes:
    in_1990 = cause in causes_1990
    in_2024 = cause in causes_2024
    cat = (causes_1990[cause]['category'] if in_1990
           else causes_2024[cause]['category'])
    color = COLORS[cat]

    if in_1990 and in_2024:
        r90 = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        r24 = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        d90 = causes_1990[cause]['dalys_millions']
        d24 = causes_2024[cause]['dalys_millions']
        shift = r90 - r24  # positive = improved (lower rank number)

        ax_slope.plot([0, 1], [r90, r24], color=color, lw=2.8,
                      alpha=0.88, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
        ax_slope.scatter([0, 1], [r90, r24], color=color, s=70,
                         zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2)
        # shift annotation
        arrow = '▲' if shift > 0 else ('▼' if shift < 0 else '●')
        shift_lbl = f'{arrow} {abs(shift)}' if shift != 0 else '—'

        ax_slope.text(-0.03, r90, f'{cause}  ({d90:.0f}M)',
                      ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9.5,
                      color=color, fontweight='bold')
        ax_slope.text(1.03, r24, f'{d24:.0f}M  {cause}',
                      ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9.5,
                      color=color, fontweight='bold')

    elif in_1990:
        r90 = causes_1990[cause]['rank']
        d90 = causes_1990[cause]['dalys_millions']
        ax_slope.scatter([0], [r90], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                         edgecolors='white', linewidths=1, alpha=0.75)
        ax_slope.text(-0.03, r90, f'{cause}  ({d90:.0f}M)',
                      ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9,
                      color=color, alpha=0.72)
        # fading tail
        ax_slope.annotate('', xy=(0.55, r90 + 0.4), xytext=(0.0, r90),
                          arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                          lw=1, alpha=0.25, linestyle='--'))
        ax_slope.text(0.57, r90 + 0.4, 'dropped out',
                      fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.45,
                      fontstyle='italic', va='center')

    elif in_2024:
        r24 = causes_2024[cause]['rank']
        d24 = causes_2024[cause]['dalys_millions']
        ax_slope.scatter([1], [r24], color=color, s=55, zorder=3,
                         edgecolors='white', linewidths=1, alpha=0.75)
        ax_slope.text(1.03, r24, f'{d24:.0f}M  {cause}',
                      ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9,
                      color=color, alpha=0.72)
        ax_slope.annotate('', xy=(1.0, r24), xytext=(0.45, r24 - 0.4),
                          arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color,
                                          lw=1, alpha=0.25, linestyle='--'))
        ax_slope.text(0.22, r24 - 0.4, 'new entry',
                      fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.45,
                      fontstyle='italic', va='center')

ax_slope.set_xlim(-0.45, 1.45)
ax_slope.set_ylim(10.8, 0.2)
ax_slope.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_slope.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax_slope.set_ylabel('DALY Rank (1 = highest burden)', fontsize=11,
                    fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax_slope.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(1))
ax_slope.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, linestyle='--', color='#AAAAAA')
ax_slope.set_title(
    'A.  Top 10 Global DALY Causes — Rank Shifts',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', loc='left', pad=12,
)

# ── Category legend for slope chart ───────────────────────────────────────
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable / Maternal / Neonatal'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-Communicable Disease (NCD)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injury'),
]
ax_slope.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='lower left', fontsize=9,
                frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
                title='Disease Category', title_fontsize=10)

# PANEL B — 100% Stacked Bars by Income Group
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

income_groups = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-middle\nincome',
                 'Upper-middle\nincome', 'High\nincome']
ig_keys = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income',
           'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
years = [1990, 2024]
bar_w = 0.32
x_base = np.arange(len(ig_keys))

for yi, year in enumerate(years):
    offset = (yi - 0.5) * bar_w
    year_rows = [d for d in data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
                 if d['year'] == year]
    row_map = {d['income_group']: d for d in year_rows}

    comm = [row_map[k]['communicable_pct'] for k in ig_keys]
    ncd  = [row_map[k]['ncd_pct'] for k in ig_keys]
    inj  = [row_map[k]['injury_pct'] for k in ig_keys]

    x = x_base + offset
    alpha = 0.95 if year == 2024 else 0.55
    hatch = '' if year == 2024 else '///'

    ax_income.bar(x, comm, bar_w, color=COLORS['Communicable'],
                  alpha=alpha, hatch=hatch, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                  label='Communicable' if yi == 0 else '')
    ax_income.bar(x, ncd, bar_w, bottom=comm, color=COLORS['NCD'],
                  alpha=alpha, hatch=hatch, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                  label='NCD' if yi == 0 else '')
    ax_income.bar(x, inj, bar_w,
                  bottom=[c + n for c, n in zip(comm, ncd)],
                  color=COLORS['Injury'], alpha=alpha,
                  hatch=hatch, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                  label='Injury' if yi == 0 else '')

    # Add percentage labels inside bars
    for j in range(len(ig_keys)):
        cx = x[j]
        # Communicable label
        if comm[j] > 8:
            ax_income.text(cx, comm[j] / 2, f'{comm[j]:.0f}%',
                           ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5,
                           color='white', fontweight='bold')
        # NCD label
        if ncd[j] > 8:
            ax_income.text(cx, comm[j] + ncd[j] / 2, f'{ncd[j]:.0f}%',
                           ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5,
                           color='white', fontweight='bold')
        # Injury label
        if inj[j] > 8:
            ax_income.text(cx, comm[j] + ncd[j] + inj[j] / 2,
                           f'{inj[j]:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                           fontsize=7.5, color='white', fontweight='bold')

# Year sub-labels under each pair
for j, ig in enumerate(ig_keys):
    ax_income.text(x_base[j] - bar_w / 2, -7, '1990',
                   ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888')
    ax_income.text(x_base[j] + bar_w / 2, -7, '2024',
                   ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color='#333333',
                   fontweight='bold')

ax_income.set_xticks(x_base)
ax_income.set_xticklabels(income_groups, fontsize=9)
ax_income.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax_income.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11,
                     fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax_income.set_title(
    'B.  Disease Burden Composition by Income Group',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', loc='left', pad=12,
)
ax_income.axhline(50, color='#AAAAAA', lw=0.5, ls=':', zorder=0)

# Mini legend for hatch meaning
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
year_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#BBBBBB', alpha=0.55, hatch='///',
                   edgecolor='white', label='1990'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#BBBBBB', alpha=0.95,
                   edgecolor='white', label='2024'),
]
leg2 = ax_income.legend(handles=year_handles, loc='upper left',
                        fontsize=8.5, frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
                        edgecolor='#CCCCCC', title='Year',
                        title_fontsize=9)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C — Global Category Totals
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_global = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']
cats = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

for yi, year in enumerate(years):
    year_rows = [d for d in global_data if d['year'] == year]
    row_map = {d['category']: d for d in year_rows}

    vals = [row_map[c]['dalys_millions'] for c in cats]
    total = sum(vals)

    x = yi
    bottoms = [0]
    for k in range(len(vals) - 1):
        bottoms.append(bottoms[-1] + vals[k])

    for ci, (cat, val, bot) in enumerate(zip(cats, vals, bottoms)):
        ax_global.bar(x, val, 0.55, bottom=bot, color=COLORS[cat],
                      alpha=0.92, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1,
                      label=cat if yi == 0 else '')
        # label
        mid = bot + val / 2
        pct = val / total * 100
        ax_global.text(x, mid, f'{val:.0f}M\n({pct:.0f}%)',
                       ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                       color='white', fontweight='bold')

    # Total label on top
    ax_global.text(x, total + 25, f'Total\n{total:.0f}M',
                   ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                   fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax_global.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_global.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax_global.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11,
                     fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax_global.set_title(
    'C.  Global DALY Totals by Category',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', loc='left', pad=12,
)
ax_global.set_ylim(0, 2650)
ax_global.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2, linestyle='--')

# ── Final legend (shared categories) ──────────────────────────────────────
cat_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable / Maternal / Neonatal'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-Communicable Disease'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injury'),
]
ax_global.legend(handles=cat_handles, loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5,
                 frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
                 title='Disease Category', title_fontsize=9)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
